meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: Use this when the user asks to search memory, "did we already solve this?", "how did we do X last time?", or wants work from previous sessions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速找回之前会话中解决过的问题和做法
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常想从过往对话里快速找回答案。
copy.tagline_en: Recall past solutions and how you did things before.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to dig up answers from earlier conversations.

howto.what: 需要回顾以前的工作时,Claude 会去查 claude-mem 的跨会话记忆库:先返回一张带 ID 的索引表,再看某条记录前后的时间线,最后只为筛选出的 ID 取完整详情。
howto.when: 当你问「这个问题之前是不是解决过」「上次是怎么做 X 的」,或需要之前会话里的工作成果时触发。

say.text: 搜一下之前会话里关于认证的记录
say.note: 先返回带 ID 的索引表

say.text: 看看 #11131 前后的时间线
把 #11131 和 #10942 的完整详情取出来

howto.what_en: When you ask about earlier sessions, Claude searches claude-mem's cross-session memory: it first returns an index table with IDs, then a timeline around a result, and only then fetches full details for the IDs you keep.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask "did we already solve this?" or "how did we do X last time?", or need work from previous sessions.

say_en.text: Search past sessions for anything about authentication
say_en.note: Returns an index table with IDs
Lists items before and after it
